Token Catppuccin Latte Iced Americano Design note

Color is only one cue.

This experimental palette is designed with protanopia and deuteranopia distinctions in mind, but has not undergone structured evaluation with color-vision-deficient users. It is not accessibility certification.

Not every swatch is suitable for normal text. Blue and Subtext0 fall below 4.5:1 on Mantle and Crust. Yellow, Pink and Teal ANSI text fall below 4.5:1 even on Base. Use Text or Subtext1 on darker surfaces, and explicit labels or icons for status.

Read usage limits · View the source palette

Iced Americano is an unofficial derivative of Catppuccin Latte, not an official Catppuccin flavor.
